_readme: Targets for examples/benchmark_insights.py. ADDING A MODEL IS ONE OBJECT IN THIS LIST — no
code changes anywhere. Adding a whole new VENDOR is one adapter class + one registry row in
examples/insights_provider.py (the production port), after which its models are configured
name     label used in the report (must be unique)
provider a name the production registry knows (RWE_INSIGHTS_PROVIDER)
model    RWE_INSIGHTS_MODEL for this target; omit to use the provider's own default
env      extra environment for this target only (endpoint, timeouts, keys via ${VAR})
pricing  USD per 1,000,000 tokens, used for the cost-per-1k-articles column.
OPERATOR-MAINTAINED: vendor prices change, and a stale number here becomes a
confident wrong answer in a report. Verify before quoting a run. Local models are
0.0 — their real cost is electricity and wall-clock, which the latency column
enabled  false keeps a target configured but skipped (default true)

targets.name: anthropic/claude-opus-4-8
targets.notes: hosted; skipped automatically when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is absent
